ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 5:95 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigment across >95% of fluke area. A localized high-contrast white patch is located on the distal edge of the right lobe. Multiple small-diameter (1-5 pixel) white focal spots are scattered across the right and central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 145 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 4% of the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge topography. The right lobe trailing edge displays low-frequency, medium-amplitude peaks. The left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Both distal tips exhibit extreme topographic irregularity due to external clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edges transitioning to convex near the distal tips. Leading edges exhibit a continuous convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (white/grey) are detected on the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented vertically/obliquely relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological growth (barnacle clusters) and associated calcified scarring at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
